reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the sachets, which is actually what I want for travel, but then the $29.99 and zero reviews. That is $1 a serving when Nature Made or Double Wood are $0.20-0.40, and I do not buy supplements with no reviews, I read the 1-star ones first.
